variants.headline: Building job cancelled part-way
variants.body: The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, has been cancelled part-way. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: Client abandons the construction plan

variants.headline: Unfinished work meets a cancelled project
